key_points: Strong backlog growth reported by ACM Research, indicating robust demand for semiconductor equipment.
Institutional ETFs added $70.3 million in LRCX, signaling continued buying interest.
LRCX rebounded 14-15% on Nov 23 after a prior 6.9% dip, reflecting positive market sentiment.
Analysts and commentary remain optimistic about record revenue and long‑term growth prospects.
No material regulatory or legal developments directly affecting LRCX; sector volatility appears driven by broader chip trends.
